verdict.rationale: macOS docs mention 'Automate tasks with Shortcuts' and Spotlight for search/actions, which could support scripted bulk operations, but there's no direct evidence of built-in bulk/batch operations across many items (e.g., batch rename, bulk file processing) tailored for AI-native workflows.
